title: Benchmark candidate model formats and quantizations on host with memory and correctness checks
goal: Benchmark harness in susi-gemi only tests synthetic word-count TPS against fake providers; lacks automated candidate format (GGUF, Safetensors, EXL2, AWQ) and quantization (Q4, Q8, FP16) benchmarking on real host engines, memory consumption checks, and live feed into placement recommendations.
